_comment: JS coverage high-water mark over src/** (see scripts/check-coverage-ratchet.mjs). These are the CONSERVATIVE MINIMUM percentages observed over several `npm test` runs (fast-check property tests jitter run-to-run), so the required `js` check never reddens on jitter. Raise with `npm run coverage:baseline` only when coverage genuinely improves, and re-confirm the new value is a floor (re-run a few times), not a lucky peak.
